title: A piece of junk!
text:
A piece of junk!. Very sad to see that Fender puts its logo on this piece of junk.
It seems the box I received contains random parts, making the stool impossible to assemble.
Unfortunately I haven't read the reviews before the purchase, now I can see many more people had the same problem.
I will return it for a refund. I really wanted this stool, but it seems that also the replacements received by the other buyers are defective.

product_metadata.title: Fender Blackout Barstool, 24in
features: Ideal for practice or jam sessions
description: Proper posture is a key element to a productive practice session. Chair arms can force you to contort uncomfortable to keep your instrument in its natural playing position while restricting your ability to move along the neck freely and forcing you into a back-killing hunched playing position. This barstool offers a stable support for your back, while working your core muscles and ensuring you have unhindered access to the entire instrument. The powder-coated base and Embossed Fender logo on the seat make it look great in any decor.
